# 80 MHz Wi-Fi CSI Human Sensing Dataset

**Aliases:** A CSI Dataset for Wireless Human Sensing on 80 MHz Wi-Fi Channels

A 23.6 GB IEEE 802.11ac CSI human-sensing dataset collected over 80 MHz channels from 13 subjects across different environments, days, and Wi-Fi hardware.
